activities.title: Colour hunt
steps: Find an object in a colour you choose.
Find another match and compare their shapes.
Sort your finds by colour and name each group.
activities.description: Find an object in a colour you choose. A playful moment to explore cognitive development together.

activities.title: Shape detectives
steps: Choose a circle, square and triangle.
Look for those shapes around the room.
Put the shapes together to make a picture.
activities.description: Choose a circle, square and triangle. A playful moment to explore cognitive development together.

activities.title: Match my pair
steps: Lay out one object from each pair.
Invite your child to find each matching object.
Mix them and try a new arrangement.
activities.description: Lay out one object from each pair. A playful moment to explore cognitive development together.

activities.title: Pattern parade
steps: Make a red-blue-red-blue pattern.
Invite your child to add the next block.
Create a new pattern together.
activities.description: Make a red-blue-red-blue pattern. A playful moment to explore cognitive development together.

activities.title: What is missing?
activities.materials: Four familiar objects and a cloth
steps: Name the objects together.
Cover them and remove one.
Uncover the objects and guess what is missing.
activities.description: Name the objects together. A playful moment to explore cognitive development together.

activities.title: Sort it your way
steps: Explore how the blocks are alike.
Sort them by shape or colour.
Try sorting the same blocks a different way.
activities.description: Explore how the blocks are alike. A playful moment to explore cognitive development together.

activities.title: Build a bridge
activities.materials: Large building blocks and a toy
steps: Place two blocks apart like riverbanks.
Try ways to bridge the gap.
Test the bridge with a lightweight toy and adjust it.
activities.description: Place two blocks apart like riverbanks. A playful moment to explore cognitive development together.

activities.title: Picture sequence
activities.materials: Three drawings of a daily routine
steps: Talk about what each picture shows.
Place the pictures in the order things happen.
Tell the little story from beginning to end.
activities.description: Talk about what each picture shows. A playful moment to explore cognitive development together.

activities.title: Clue trail
steps: Choose a toy and give a simple clue.
Let your child explore and find the match.
Swap roles and listen to your child’s clues.
activities.description: Choose a toy and give a simple clue. A playful moment to explore cognitive development together.

activities.title: Animal moves
steps: Stretch tall like a giraffe.
Walk slowly like a bear.
Choose an animal and invent its movement.
activities.description: Stretch tall like a giraffe. A playful moment to explore physical development together.

activities.title: Roll to me
steps: Sit facing each other.
Roll the ball gently between you.
Move a little farther apart and try again.
activities.description: Sit facing each other. A playful moment to explore physical development together.

activities.title: Follow the footprints
steps: Place footprints along a clear path.
Step slowly from one to the next.
Try a new path with gentle turns.
activities.description: Place footprints along a clear path. A playful moment to explore physical development together.

activities.title: Balance trail
activities.materials: Masking tape on a flat floor
steps: Make a short tape line.
Walk along it with arms stretched out.
Try carrying a soft toy as you walk.
activities.description: Make a short tape line. A playful moment to explore physical development together.

activities.title: Toss and land
activities.materials: Soft beanbags and a wide basket
steps: Place the basket close by.
Toss a beanbag gently into it.
Adjust the distance to keep it comfortable.
activities.description: Place the basket close by. A playful moment to explore physical development together.

activities.title: Stretch like a tree
steps: Plant your feet comfortably.
Raise your arms like growing branches.
Sway gently and come back to the middle.
activities.description: Plant your feet comfortably. A playful moment to explore physical development together.

activities.title: Little obstacle path
steps: Arrange a low, stable cushion path.
Step around or over each cushion with support.
Let your child suggest the next route.
activities.description: Arrange a low, stable cushion path. A playful moment to explore physical development together.

activities.title: Move and freeze
steps: Choose a favourite movement.
Say freeze and balance in place.
Take turns calling move and freeze.
activities.description: Choose a favourite movement. A playful moment to explore physical development together.

activities.title: Ribbon dance
steps: Wave the fabric slowly from side to side.
Draw big circles in the air.
Make up a short dance together.
activities.description: Wave the fabric slowly from side to side. A playful moment to explore physical development together.

activities.title: Feeling faces
steps: Make a happy face together.
Try a sad or surprised face.
Name a time you felt that way.
activities.description: Make a happy face together. A playful moment to explore emotional development together.

activities.title: My calm breath
steps: Sit comfortably together.
Smell an imaginary flower slowly.
Blow an imaginary candle gently and repeat.
activities.description: Sit comfortably together. A playful moment to explore emotional development together.

activities.title: Today feels like
steps: Choose a colour for your feeling.
Draw marks that show that feeling.
Listen as your child tells you about the picture.
activities.description: Choose a colour for your feeling. A playful moment to explore emotional development together.

activities.title: Feelings weather
steps: Imagine feelings as sunny, cloudy or rainy.
Draw today’s feelings weather.
Talk about what might help on a cloudy day.
activities.description: Imagine feelings as sunny, cloudy or rainy. A playful moment to explore emotional development together.

activities.title: A cosy corner
steps: Find a comfortable quiet spot.
Choose something that feels comforting.
Practise asking for a little quiet time.
activities.description: Find a comfortable quiet spot. A playful moment to explore emotional development together.

activities.title: Name that feeling
steps: Act out a toy losing something.
Ask how the toy might feel.
Find a kind way to help the toy.
activities.description: Act out a toy losing something. A playful moment to explore emotional development together.

activities.title: Brave little try
steps: Talk about something new to try.
Draw one small first step.
Celebrate the effort of trying that step.
activities.description: Talk about something new to try. A playful moment to explore emotional development together.

activities.title: My helpful words
steps: Let one toy feel frustrated.
Practise words such as I need help.
Use the words in a gentle pretend conversation.
activities.description: Let one toy feel frustrated. A playful moment to explore emotional development together.

activities.title: Feelings journey
steps: Recall a small moment from today.
Draw how the feeling changed.
Talk about what helped along the way.
activities.description: Recall a small moment from today. A playful moment to explore emotional development together.

activities.title: My turn, your turn
steps: Say my turn before rolling the ball.
Invite your child to say your turn.
Keep taking turns at a comfortable pace.
activities.description: Say my turn before rolling the ball. A playful moment to explore social development together.

activities.title: Hello little friend
steps: Say hello to the toy by name.
Ask the toy a friendly question.
Let your child answer and ask a question too.
activities.description: Say hello to the toy by name. A playful moment to explore social development together.

activities.title: Build together
steps: Choose something to build together.
Add one block each in turn.
Give your creation a shared name.
activities.description: Choose something to build together. A playful moment to explore social development together.

activities.title: Kindness delivery
steps: Think of someone to thank.
Draw a little picture for them.
Practise a kind sentence to go with it.
activities.description: Think of someone to thank. A playful moment to explore social development together.

activities.title: Listen and draw
steps: Describe a simple shape.
Listen as your child draws it.
Swap roles and follow their description.
activities.description: Describe a simple shape. A playful moment to explore social development together.

activities.title: Our shared picnic
steps: Set a pretend place for each toy.
Share the pretend food fairly.
Ask each toy what it would like.
activities.description: Set a pretend place for each toy. A playful moment to explore social development together.

activities.title: Solve it together
activities.materials: Two toys and one toy car
steps: Pretend both toys want the car.
Think of ways they could take turns.
Try one idea and talk about how it feels.
activities.description: Pretend both toys want the car. A playful moment to explore social development together.

activities.title: Team treasure map
steps: Draw a map to a familiar toy.
Choose one job for each person.
Follow the map together and celebrate teamwork.
activities.description: Draw a map to a familiar toy. A playful moment to explore social development together.

activities.title: Little helpers
steps: Choose a small task together.
Let each person pick one part.
Finish together and thank each other.
activities.description: Choose a small task together. A playful moment to explore social development together.

activities.title: Scribble garden
steps: Make a few playful marks.
Turn one mark into a leaf or flower.
Add an imaginary creature to your garden.
activities.description: Make a few playful marks. A playful moment to explore creative development together.

activities.title: Cloud stories
steps: Draw a soft cloud shape.
Imagine what it could become.
Tell a little story about your cloud.
activities.description: Draw a soft cloud shape. A playful moment to explore creative development together.

activities.title: Sound explorers
steps: Make a quiet clap or tap.
Copy each other’s sound.
Combine your sounds into a rhythm.
activities.description: Make a quiet clap or tap. A playful moment to explore creative development together.

activities.title: Paper creatures
activities.materials: Large paper pieces and a glue stick
steps: Arrange paper into a creature.
Choose its eyes, wings or feet.
Name it and describe where it lives.
activities.description: Arrange paper into a creature. A playful moment to explore creative development together.

activities.title: Paint a rhythm
steps: Tap a gentle rhythm together.
Draw lines that follow the rhythm.
Change the rhythm and add new marks.
activities.description: Tap a gentle rhythm together. A playful moment to explore creative development together.

activities.title: My pretend shop
steps: Arrange objects in a pretend shop.
Invent names for what you sell.
Take turns being shopkeeper and visitor.
activities.description: Arrange objects in a pretend shop. A playful moment to explore creative development together.

activities.title: Invent a vehicle
steps: Imagine a vehicle for a special journey.
Build it with blocks.
Explain its special features through pretend play.
activities.description: Imagine a vehicle for a special journey. A playful moment to explore creative development together.

activities.title: A story in three pictures
steps: Draw a character and a place.
Draw something surprising that happens.
Draw an ending and tell the whole story.
activities.description: Draw a character and a place. A playful moment to explore creative development together.

activities.title: Our little show
activities.materials: Toys and a small clear stage
steps: Choose characters for a short show.
Practise a beginning, middle and ending.
Perform together and celebrate every idea.
activities.description: Choose characters for a short show. A playful moment to explore creative development together.

kits.title: Little discovery kit
kits.description: Large sorting shapes, colour cards and playful discovery prompts.

kits.title: Little makers kit
kits.description: Paper shapes, washable crayons and imaginative making prompts.

kits.title: Move & play kit
kits.description: A soft ball, floor markers and movement activity cards.
